# graph-manager: GitHub and GitLab connections with personal access tokens (+ fake forge)

## What to build

In `apps/graph-manager`, let the owner connect GitHub and GitLab with personal access tokens. This task adds:

- a forge client module used by later tasks: verify, list repos, clone auth, create PR/MR
- REST routes to save, verify, list and remove connections
- the **Settings** page UI
- a standalone **fake forge** server for tests and the live tester

Tokens are stored in the data store (`apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`, field `forges`) and are never returned to the browser.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts`: `buildApp(config, opts)`, `AppContext = { config, store }`, and the comment `// feature routes (one line per feature)` where you register `forgeRoutes`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`: `DataStore.get()` and `update(fn)`. The schema already has `forges.github {token, login}` and `forges.gitlab {token, login, baseUrl}`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/config.ts`: `config.githubApiUrl` (`GM_GITHUB_API_URL`, default `https://api.github.com`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.test.ts`: the test pattern (temp dataDir, `buildApp`, `app.inject`, log in first to get a cookie). Copy its login helper into a shared `src/server/test-helpers.ts` (`appWithLogin(overrides?) → { app, cookie, config, store, cleanup }`) if one doesn't exist yet.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx`: the placeholder to replace. `src/web/api.ts` has the `api()` fetch wrapper.
- `TESTING.md` (root), "graph-manager" section: append how to run the fake forge.

## Patterns to follow

**Forge client interface** (`src/server/forges.ts`):
```ts
export type ForgeKind = "github" | "gitlab";
export interface ForgeRepo { fullPath: string; name: string; defaultBranch: string; cloneUrl: string; private: boolean; webUrl: string }
export interface ForgeConn { kind: ForgeKind; token: string; apiUrl: string }  // github: config.githubApiUrl; gitlab: `${baseUrl}/api/v4`
export interface PullRequest { url: string; number: number }
export interface ForgeClient {
  verify(): Promise<{ login: string }>;                         // GitHub GET /user → login; GitLab GET /user → username
  listRepos(query?: string): Promise<ForgeRepo[]>;             // first 100, sorted by last push/activity
  getRepo(fullPath: string): Promise<ForgeRepo>;
  createPullRequest(p: { fullPath: string; head: string; base: string; title: string; body: string }): Promise<PullRequest>;
}
export function forgeClient(conn: ForgeConn): ForgeClient;
export function gitAuthArgs(kind: ForgeKind, token: string): string[];  // ["-c", `http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic ${b64(user + ":" + token)}`]; user "x-access-token" (github) or "oauth2" (gitlab)
export class ForgeError extends Error { constructor(readonly status: number, message: string) }
```

**GitHub REST** (headers `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `Accept: application/vnd.github+json`, `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28`):
- `GET /user`
- `GET /user/repos?per_page=100&sort=pushed&affiliation=owner,collaborator,organization_member`, mapped as `full_name→fullPath`, `default_branch`, `clone_url`, `private`, `html_url`
- `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}`
- `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls {title, head, base, body}` returns `html_url` and `number`

**GitLab REST v4** (header `PRIVATE-TOKEN: <token>`):
- `GET /user`
- `GET /projects?membership=true&per_page=100&order_by=last_activity_at&simple=true[&search=q]`, mapped as `path_with_namespace→fullPath`, `default_branch`, `http_url_to_repo`, `visibility!=="public"`, `web_url`
- `GET /projects/{encodeURIComponent(fullPath)}`
- `POST /projects/{id}/merge_requests {source_branch, target_branch, title, description}` returns `web_url` and `iid`

**Errors:**
- A non-2xx response throws `ForgeError(status, "<forge> <status>: <message from body or statusText>")`.
- Network errors throw `ForgeError(502, …)`.
- Never put the token into an error message.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/forges.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: as above, using global `fetch`.
- Also export `connFor(ctx, kind): ForgeConn | undefined`, built from the store and config, and `clientFor(ctx, kind)`, which throws `ForgeError(400, "<kind> is not connected")`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/forges.ts` and register it in `app.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `GET /api/forges` returns `{ github: {connected, login?}, gitlab: {connected, login?, baseUrl?} }`. Never the token.
  - `PUT /api/forges/github {token}` and `PUT /api/forges/gitlab {token, baseUrl}`:
    - `baseUrl` defaults to `https://gitlab.com`; strip trailing slashes; must be http(s).
    - Verify with `forgeClient(...).verify()`. On failure answer 400 `{error}` with the forge's message and save nothing.
    - On success save `{token, login, baseUrl?}` and answer `{connected:true, login}`.
  - `DELETE /api/forges/:kind` returns 204.
  - `GET /api/forges/:kind/repos?q=` returns `{repos: ForgeRepo[]}`; 400 when not connected.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs`

A plain ESM Node script, no TypeScript, so both tests and the live tester can run it.

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export async function startFakeForge({ port = 0, dir } = {}) → { url, close(), pulls: [] , addRepo(fullPath) }`.
  - Serves both APIs from one `http` server: GitHub at `<url>/github/...` (so `GM_GITHUB_API_URL=<url>/github`) and GitLab at `<url>/gitlab/api/v4/...` (so the GitLab `baseUrl=<url>/gitlab`).
  - **Tokens:** valid tokens are `gh-good` (login `octo`) and `gl-good` (username `gitlab-user`). Anything else gets 401 `{message:"Bad credentials"}`.
  - **Repos:**
    - `addRepo(fullPath)` creates a bare repo `<dir>/<fullPath>.git` with one commit on `main` containing `README.md`. Create it with git through `child_process.execFileSync`: `git init --bare -b main`, plus a temp clone that commits and pushes.
    - Clone URLs are `file://<dir>/<fullPath>.git`.
    - It starts with GitHub repo `octo/hello` and GitLab project `grp/sub/proj`.
  - **Pull requests:**
    - `POST /pulls` and `POST /merge_requests` record `{forge, fullPath, head, base, title, body}` in `pulls` and return a fake URL and number (1, 2, …).
    - The PR fails with 422 when the head branch doesn't exist in the bare repo (`git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/<head>` in the bare repo).
    - `GET /__fake/pulls` returns `pulls`.
  - **Standalone:** `node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs [port] [dir]` starts it and prints `fake forge on <url>` plus the env lines to use.

### REPLACE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: two cards, **GitHub** and **GitLab**.
  - **Not connected:** a token password field (GitLab also has a Base URL field, default `https://gitlab.com`) and a **Connect** button.
  - **Connected:** `Connected as <login>` (plus the base URL) and a **Disconnect** button.
  - Show the API error text under the card on failure.
  - Add `data-testid`s: `forge-github`, `forge-gitlab`, `token-input`, `connect`, `disconnect`.

### CREATE tests

- **`src/server/forges.test.ts`**: start the fake forge (`import { startFakeForge } from "../../scripts/fake-forge.mjs"`; add a `scripts/fake-forge.d.mts` declaration file if TypeScript needs it, or `// @ts-expect-error`-free typing via JSDoc). Then:
  - GitHub `verify` with `gh-good` gives `octo`; with `bad` it throws `ForgeError(401)`.
  - `listRepos` includes `octo/hello` with a `file://` cloneUrl.
  - GitLab works the same way (`grp/sub/proj`).
  - `createPullRequest` records the pull.
  - `gitAuthArgs("github","t")` contains `Basic eC1hY2Nlc3MtdG9rZW46dA==`.
- **`src/server/routes/forges.test.ts`**:
  - `PUT /api/forges/github {token:"gh-good"}` with `githubApiUrl` pointing at the fake gives 200 `{login:"octo"}`.
  - `GET /api/forges` shows connected and the body has no `gh-good` anywhere.
  - A bad token gives 400 and stays not connected.
  - `DELETE` disconnects.
  - GitLab works the same way with `baseUrl: <fake>/gitlab`.
  - `GET /api/forges/github/repos` lists `octo/hello`.

### UPDATE `TESTING.md` (root), "graph-manager" section

- **IMPLEMENT**: add the forge steps:
  ```bash
  node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs 7421 $GM_DIR/forge &
  # start graph-manager with GM_GITHUB_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7421/github
  # Settings → GitHub token: gh-good (login octo). GitLab: token gl-good, base URL http://127.0.0.1:7421/gitlab
  ```
- Note: no real tokens are needed or allowed in tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `PUT /api/forges/github` and `PUT /api/forges/gitlab` verify against the forge; valid tokens are saved and shown with the login, invalid ones give 400 with the forge's message.
- [ ] No API response or log line ever contains a token.
- [ ] The Settings page connects and disconnects both forges.
- [ ] `forgeClient` supports verify, listRepos, getRepo and createPullRequest for both forges against the fake forge.
- [ ] Root `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager
```
